content.summary: Work items generated from commit plan for Provider Quota Widget

work_items.title: Provider Quota Service
work_items.description: Core service for fetching and normalizing quota data from provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenRouter)
acceptance_criteria: Define QuotaInfo type with quota-based and pay-as-you-go fields
Implement ProviderQuota.fetch(providerID) using Auth.get() for tokens

work_items.title: Sidebar Quota Widget Component
work_items.description: TUI component displaying quota info in sidebar with reactive updates
acceptance_criteria: Create QuotaWidget component showing usage %, reset time, weekly cost
Integrate into sidebar.tsx after Context section
Use theme system for consistent styling with color coding by quota level
Reactive updates on provider change and message send

work_items.title: Quota Caching and Error Handling
work_items.description: Resilience layer with TTL caching and graceful error handling
acceptance_criteria: Implement in-memory cache with 60-second default TTL
fetchCached() returns cached data within TTL, else fetches fresh
Network/auth/rate-limit errors return null, never throw
Add debug logging via Log.create({ service: 'provider-quota' })
Widget shows '--' fallback when service returns null

data.build_order: quota-service -> (quota-widget, quota-cache) in parallel possible but sequential recommended
